description: Lists Israeli reporting and payment deadlines for a period and returns them as a structured list plus an .ics calendar file with reminders: for a business by type (osek patur, osek murshe, company; VAT frequency, income-tax advances, employees) from the published Tax Authority and National Insurance tables, or personal tax dates (annual report, tax-refund windows, employer forms). | לוח מועדים לעסק או אישי, כקובץ ליומן. Stateless: arguments and results are never stored, logged or shared (nayeret.ai/developers/). Not legal or tax advice.

business_start.description: Business opening date (no duties before it)

employees.description: Number of employees (adds withholding and employer reports)

income_tax_advances.description: Income tax advance payments. Default monthly

micro_business.description: Osek patur that is a "small business" (עסק זעיר) with the simplified annual report

online_reporting.description: Reports online (later online due dates). Default true

pays_national_insurance.description: Pays National Insurance as self-employed (default true; not for companies)

type.description: patur = osek patur (exempt dealer), murshe = osek murshe (licensed dealer), company = company (Ltd)

vat_frequency.description: VAT reporting frequency (not for patur). Default bimonthly

from.description: Start of the period (default: today in Israel). The business engine always covers 12 months from this date.

kind.description: business = reporting and payment duties of a business (VAT, income tax advances, withholding, National Insurance, annual reports); personal = personal tax dates (refund windows, annual report, forms from the employer)

lang.description: Language of the summary text: he (default) or en. Files stay in Hebrew (official forms and Israeli letters).

months.description: Length of the period in months (default 12; business max 12)

reminder_days_before.description: Add a calendar alarm this many days before each date (0 = none, default 3)

name: deadlines_calendar
title: Israeli compliance deadlines calendar (.ics)
